rootCause.gateScope: Gate 10.9 was constructed and authorized for five preselected one-to-one cases, not for the complete registered source universe.
rootCause.commissionSeparation: Commission planillas were processed in a separate domain and only five aggregate relationships were written; eligible rows were not converted automatically into confirmed collections.
rootCause.missingDurableContract: The runtime has no complete durable ledger for reported payments, evidence, reconciliation proposals and holds.
rootCause.uiProjection: Cobros reads the materialized cobros collection; Conciliaciones reads conciliaciones and conciliacionesPrimas. Private dry-runs and source registries are not automatically projected into those collections.

canonicalCollectionsRequired.pagosReportados: one durable row per normalized CRM payment report
canonicalCollectionsRequired.evidenciasCobro: insurer payment, portfolio timeline, commission and bank support with provenance
canonicalCollectionsRequired.propuestasConciliacion: scored links between evidence and operational receipts
canonicalCollectionsRequired.conciliacionHolds: all unresolved differences with reason and required action

invariants: reported payment is not automatically a confirmed collection
commission evidence alone does not apply a payment
portfolio disappearance alone does not apply a payment
bank evidence alone does not apply a payment
no source row may disappear because it is not yet confirmable
every source row must end as linked, proposed, held, omitted as duplicate, or requires validation
the same registered source hash must not be requested or imported again
no financial movement is created from the collections domain

nextGate.type: full-source read-only replay before any write
requiredResults: deduplication by source hash and row identity
